authority: Web/backend database RPC; clients never decide eligibility, paper contents, time, score, result or attempts

rpcs.name: training_exam_start
rpcs.authorization: current user must own the admission and remain an active project member
rpcs.idempotency: an existing ongoing requirement is resumed; optional key and database uniqueness serialize retries

rpcs.name: training_exam_get
rpcs.answer_safety: questions never include correct answers or internal analysis

rpcs.name: training_exam_submit
rpcs.idempotency: the first terminal result is immutable and repeated submit returns it
rpcs.grading: server grades against the attempt answer snapshot and percentage pass score

rpcs.name: training_exam_report_switch
rpcs.effect: audit signal only; it cannot alter score or result

rpcs.name: training_exam_project_summary
rpcs.answer_safety: summary contains no questions, answers or answer keys

prerequisites.formal_internal: consume only the authoritative D11 training_three_level_status.exam_allowed result for the current employment relation; D13 never resolves organization, scheme, stages, or packages
prerequisites.contractor_and_temporary_individual: require an active completed project-level admission training task; absent source fails closed and never creates employee three-level history
prerequisites.visitor: blocked and routed to visitor safety briefing
prerequisites.special: consume the exact current D12 requirement, certificate state, training completion and exact published special exam configuration; pass facts are isolated by admission/project/person/special type/plan

time: deadline and timeout are decided using server clock; deadline is exclusive and 30:00 is timed out
history: question, option, answer and rule snapshots plus attempts and events are persisted; submitted attempts cannot be updated or deleted and cannot satisfy another project's special requirement
boundary: D13 records exam facts only; D18 owns final work eligibility
